card.name: Last digit of platelet count thresholds
card.fires_on: The final digit or unit word that completes a number in a blood count or titer, such as the last 0 in 50,000 or the 9 in 10 x 10^9 /L. Seen mostly after platelet count thresholds, and also after plaque-forming.

modes.label: Platelet count digit
modes.description: The last 0 of a thousands figure or the 9 in a 10^9/L exponent after a platelet count threshold.
